material.source: Angeli 2022 published three-shell GSFE coefficients; the 2024 Erratum does not modify the GSFE coefficients or conjugate phase pairing

preparation.zero_force_state: lowest-energy stable minimum in one primitive registry cell
preparation.loading_protocol: adiabatic continuation of that same minimum

static.depinning_definition: loss of positive-definite Hessian on the prepared branch
static.generic_label_policy: use fold/saddle-node only where nondegeneracy conditions hold; otherwise stability/depinning boundary

stage_variations.same_spectrum_symmetry: change only centered odd Fourier sector; preserve geometry and dynamics
stage_variations.finite_size_shape: change compact contact geometry/N; re-identify prepared zero-force ground state for each geometry
stage_variations.boundary: change triangular boundary orientation; enumerate competing registry minima and select lowest-energy prepared state
stage_variations.vector_mode_map: change F0 and period only; keep unguided prepared baseline
stage_variations.thermal: add Langevin noise to the same unguided deterministic model
stage_variations.elasticity: secondary model-form extension adding internal in-plane degrees of freedom
stage_variations.guided_comparison: secondary device-control branch only; k_perp > 0 is never part of the headline baseline

legacy_config_policy.config/production.json: legacy guided v17/v18 settings; provenance only, not canonical headline baseline
